name: Paragon Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Paragon Technologies specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of vacuum sputtering products, which includes solutions for electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection. The company provides a range of 3C functional coatings applied to electronics such as notebook computers, tablets, all-in-one PCs, smart PCs, and specialized computing systems for automotive and military use. They also offer 3C aesthetic coatings for items like smartphone and tablet rear covers, laptop housing components, smart watch bezels, smart home appliance panels, AIO PC back panels, mini PC enclosures, and gaming console bodies and controllers. Additionally, Paragon Technologies offers decorative sputtering services for wheel rims and is involved in the wholesale and retail of parts and equipment for automobiles and locomotives. The company, established in 1984, is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
